column1: # VPro draw-level goldens (src/dev/odyssey/golden). One scene a line:
#   name  hash(blake3 of colour, depth, stencil)  colour_delta colour_bad depth_delta depth_bad stencil_bad
# The hash is the default, bit-exact check. The five numbers are the limits for
# VPRO_GOLDEN=tolerance: pixels past colour_delta (per channel) or depth_delta (24-bit
# word) may number at most colour_bad / depth_bad, and at most stencil_bad stencil pixels
# may differ. Edit them by hand per scene; blessing keeps what is there.
